header.running_head: 4. Virtues of the Dhikr of Allah...

blocks.tamil_translation: Allah,' I said. “Shall I teach you some Kalimahs? Even if you were to do Dhikr continuously night and day, you could not attain the reward that is gained through these Kalimahs,' said the Prophet ﷺ. “Please do tell me,' I said. (اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّهِ عَدَدَ مَاأَحْصَي كِتَابُهُ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّهِ عَدَدَ مَا فيِ كِتَابِهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّهِ عَدَدَ مَا أَحْصَي خَلْقُهُ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّهِ مِلْءَ مَافِي خَلْقِهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّهِ مِلْءَ سَمَاوَاتِهِ وَأَرْضِهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّهِ عَدَدَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّهِ عَلي كُلِّ شَيْءٍ) (All praise belongs to Allah Ta'ala to the measure of the things His Book has enumerated! All praise belongs to Allah Ta'ala to the number of the things that are in His Book! All praise belongs to Allah Ta'ala to the number of the things His creation has counted! All praise belongs to Allah Ta'ala to the extent of filling the things that are in His creation!. All praise belongs to Allah Ta'ala to the extent of filling the space between the heavens and the earth! All praise belongs to Allah Ta'ala to the number of every thing! All praise belongs to Allah Ta'ala upon every thing. He told me to do Tasbih and to say Takbir in the same way as well.

blocks.text: Explanation:- In the long Kalimah above, in place of Alhamdulillah one should also say Subhanallah, and in the same way Allahu Akbar.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ﵄ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: أَوَّلُ مَنْ يُدْعي إِلَي الْجَنَّةِ الَّذِينَ يَحْمَدُونَ اللهَ فِي السَّرَّاءِ وَالضَّرَّاءِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الحاكم وقَالَ: صحيح علي شرط مسلم ولم يخرجاه ووافقه الذهبي:٥٠٢/١
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Ibn Abbas (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said: “The first to be called to Jannah will be those who praised Allah Ta'ala both in prosperity and in adversity.”
